vibe: Objective, authoritative, functional, clear, and trustworthy. The anti-bureaucracy aesthetic.

primary.description: International Klein Blue - for primary actions and routing logic

secondary.description: Pitch Black - for secondary actions and high-contrast accents

accent.description: Signal Red - for urgency, errors, and critical steps

background.description: Stark White base with 10% Grey alternative surfaces

styles.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none
styles.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight
styles.label: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-secondary

rules.headings: Never center by default. Left-align for objective clarity.
rules.hierarchy: Hierarchy gap rule: Do not exceed 2 Tailwind steps between heading and subheading.

marketing.philosophy: Asymmetry and tension. Use empty columns (col-span-2) to create negative space.

app_dashboard.philosophy: The Control Room. Dense, border-collapse style. Every pixel utilized. No soft shadows.

borders_and_surfaces.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-black/10 (Only for sticky headers)

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white font-bold uppercase tracking-wide rounded-none border border-transparent hover:bg-primary-hover transition-colors px-6 py-3
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-strong border border-strong font-bold uppercase tracking-wide rounded-none hover:bg-strong hover:text-white transition-colors px-6 py-3

cards.active: bg-background-alt border border-strong p-6 rounded-none relative after:absolute after:left-0 after:top-0 after:h-full after:w-1 after:bg-primary

forms.input: bg-transparent border border-border rounded-none focus:border-strong focus:ring-1 focus:ring-strong transition-all h-12 px-4 font-mono text-sm
forms.label: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-secondary mb-2 block

special.ai_confirmation: Use the 'Tracing Beam' concept (linear gradient border mask or an animated outline) around the AI simplified text to highlight the machine-processing step.
special.step_by_step: Use a vertical timeline with 1px solid black lines connecting stark, numbered squares (e.g., '01', '02'). Minimalist, no soft icons.

motion.hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) for dashboard cards, border color darkens to pitch black. Fast transition (150ms ease).
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-up for bento grid items. Stiff spring animation to feel mechanical and precise.

rules.overlays: Max bg-black/30 or bg-white/40 for hero images. Never go darker. If text is unreadable, use text-shadow or a gradient fade.
rules.style: High contrast, architectural, real people in urban environments. No illustrative vectors.

hero_architecture.alt: Modern brutalist government building facade against blue sky
hero_architecture.usage: Hero section background or contextual image for the 'About/Mission' section. Blend with white using a harsh linear gradient.

user_context.alt: Woman looking at her cell phone in the city
user_context.usage: Use in 'How it Works' or the landing page to represent the citizen dealing with an issue on the go.

abstract_process.alt: Dynamic blue geometric pattern with intersecting lines
abstract_process.usage: Use as a textured background for the AI processing step or the portal routing outcome to visually represent 'sorting and directing data'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the Swiss & High-Contrast archetype. Do not introduce soft shadows (shadow-md, shadow-lg) or large border radii (rounded-lg, rounded-xl, rounded-full) on standard containers.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the marketing homepage layout to achieve an overlapping, asymmetrical grid. Do not use Shadcn 'Card' wrappers for the hero section.
For the main app flow (Authentication, Problem Input, Portal Routing), use customized Shadcn components. Override default Shadcn border-radius to `rounded-none` or `rounded-sm`.
The primary action button (e.g., 'Simplify My Problem', 'Go to Portal') must use the International Klein Blue (#002FA7). All secondary buttons should be stark black outline.
Voice input needs a prominent, high-contrast CTA, perhaps an icon button with a stark border and hover state.
Implement the step-by-step guidance as a technical, clean accordion or a rigid vertical timeline with 1px black lines.
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) with the 'regular' or 'bold' weight for a technical, crisp feel.
Ensure all interactive elements have a `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case.
